# Appendix

Below is the full results table aggregated from every combination of model used:

```{r}
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
tagList(
  tags$style(HTML("
    table.dataTable {
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter,
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length,
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_info,
    .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate {
      font-size: 12px;
    }
  ")),
  datatable(
    results_agg,
    options = list(
      paging = FALSE,
      scrollY = "400px",
      scrollX = TRUE,       
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      fixedHeader = TRUE 
    ),
    class = "nowrap stripe",
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
    formatRound(columns = which(sapply(results_agg, is.numeric)), digits = 4)
)
```
